title: JSON Lines selection and physical line boundaries for protobuf
summary: The compact encoder now selects JSONL and produces two parseable records. The default printer produced 12 physical lines for those two messages, none independently parseable.

change.description: The protobuf JSON encoder adds application/jsonl to the media types it can encode. Its streaming media list already advertised that type.

notes: The observer concatenates the actual bytes and splits at LF. Each complete record is checked against its original generated message. NDJSON with the compact printer stayed stable.
